BatchGetNamedQuery.name: BatchGetNamedQuery
BatchGetNamedQuery.doc: Returns the details of a single named query or a list of up to 50 queries, which you provide as an array of query ID strings. Requires you to have access to the workgroup in which the queries were saved. Use ListNamedQueriesInput to get the list of named query IDs in the specified workgroup. If information could not be retrieved for a submitted query ID, information about the query ID submitted…

BatchGetPreparedStatement.name: BatchGetPreparedStatement
BatchGetPreparedStatement.doc: Returns the details of a single prepared statement or a list of up to 256 prepared statements for the array of prepared statement names that you provide. Requires you to have access to the workgroup to which the prepared statements belong. If a prepared statement cannot be retrieved for the name specified, the statement is listed in UnprocessedPreparedStatementNames.

BatchGetQueryExecution.name: BatchGetQueryExecution
BatchGetQueryExecution.doc: Returns the details of a single query execution or a list of up to 50 query executions, which you provide as an array of query execution ID strings. Requires you to have access to the workgroup in which the queries ran. To get a list of query execution IDs, use ListQueryExecutionsInput$WorkGroup. Query executions differ from named (saved) queries. Use BatchGetNamedQueryInput to get details about…

CancelCapacityReservation.name: CancelCapacityReservation
CancelCapacityReservation.doc: Cancels the capacity reservation with the specified name. Cancelled reservations remain in your account and will be deleted 45 days after cancellation. During the 45 days, you cannot re-purpose or reuse a reservation that has been cancelled, but you can refer to its tags and view it for historical reference.

CreateCapacityReservation.name: CreateCapacityReservation
CreateCapacityReservation.doc: Creates a capacity reservation with the specified name and number of requested data processing units.

CreateDataCatalog.name: CreateDataCatalog
CreateDataCatalog.doc: Creates (registers) a data catalog with the specified name and properties. Catalogs created are visible to all users of the same Amazon Web Services account. For a FEDERATED catalog, this API operation creates the following resources. CFN Stack Name with a maximum length of 128 characters and prefix athenafederatedcatalog-CATALOG_NAME_SANITIZED with length 23 characters. Lambda Function Name with…

CreateNamedQuery.name: CreateNamedQuery
CreateNamedQuery.doc: Creates a named query in the specified workgroup. Requires that you have access to the workgroup.

CreateNotebook.name: CreateNotebook
CreateNotebook.doc: Creates an empty ipynb file in the specified Apache Spark enabled workgroup. Throws an error if a file in the workgroup with the same name already exists.

CreatePreparedStatement.name: CreatePreparedStatement
CreatePreparedStatement.doc: Creates a prepared statement for use with SQL queries in Athena.

CreatePresignedNotebookUrl.name: CreatePresignedNotebookUrl
CreatePresignedNotebookUrl.doc: Gets an authentication token and the URL at which the notebook can be accessed. During programmatic access, CreatePresignedNotebookUrl must be called every 10 minutes to refresh the authentication token. For information about granting programmatic access, see Grant programmatic access.

CreateWorkGroup.name: CreateWorkGroup
CreateWorkGroup.doc: Creates a workgroup with the specified name. A workgroup can be an Apache Spark enabled workgroup or an Athena SQL workgroup.

DeleteCapacityReservation.name: DeleteCapacityReservation
DeleteCapacityReservation.doc: Deletes a cancelled capacity reservation. A reservation must be cancelled before it can be deleted. A deleted reservation is immediately removed from your account and can no longer be referenced, including by its ARN. A deleted reservation cannot be called by GetCapacityReservation, and deleted reservations do not appear in the output of ListCapacityReservations.

DeleteNamedQuery.name: DeleteNamedQuery
DeleteNamedQuery.doc: Deletes the named query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query was saved.

DeletePreparedStatement.name: DeletePreparedStatement
DeletePreparedStatement.doc: Deletes the prepared statement with the specified name from the specified workgroup.

DeleteWorkGroup.name: DeleteWorkGroup
DeleteWorkGroup.doc: Deletes the workgroup with the specified name. The primary workgroup cannot be deleted.

ExportNotebook.name: ExportNotebook
ExportNotebook.doc: Exports the specified notebook and its metadata.

GetCalculationExecution.name: GetCalculationExecution
GetCalculationExecution.doc: Describes a previously submitted calculation execution.

GetCalculationExecutionCode.name: GetCalculationExecutionCode
GetCalculationExecutionCode.doc: Retrieves the unencrypted code that was executed for the calculation.

GetCalculationExecutionStatus.name: GetCalculationExecutionStatus
GetCalculationExecutionStatus.doc: Gets the status of a current calculation.

GetCapacityAssignmentConfiguration.name: GetCapacityAssignmentConfiguration
GetCapacityAssignmentConfiguration.doc: Gets the capacity assignment configuration for a capacity reservation, if one exists.

GetCapacityReservation.name: GetCapacityReservation
GetCapacityReservation.doc: Returns information about the capacity reservation with the specified name.

GetDatabase.name: GetDatabase
GetDatabase.doc: Returns a database object for the specified database and data catalog.

GetNamedQuery.name: GetNamedQuery
GetNamedQuery.doc: Returns information about a single query. Requires that you have access to the workgroup in which the query was saved.

GetNotebookMetadata.name: GetNotebookMetadata
GetNotebookMetadata.doc: Retrieves notebook metadata for the specified notebook ID.

GetPreparedStatement.name: GetPreparedStatement
GetPreparedStatement.doc: Retrieves the prepared statement with the specified name from the specified workgroup.

GetQueryExecution.name: GetQueryExecution
GetQueryExecution.doc: Returns information about a single execution of a query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query ran. Each time a query executes, information about the query execution is saved with a unique ID.

GetQueryResults.name: GetQueryResults
GetQueryResults.doc: Streams the results of a single query execution specified by QueryExecutionId from the Athena query results location in Amazon S3. For more information, see Working with query results, recent queries, and output files in the Amazon Athena User Guide. This request does not execute the query but returns results. Use StartQueryExecution to run a query. To stream query results successfully, the IAM…

GetQueryRuntimeStatistics.name: GetQueryRuntimeStatistics
GetQueryRuntimeStatistics.doc: Returns query execution runtime statistics related to a single execution of a query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query ran. Statistics from the Timeline section of the response object are available as soon as QueryExecutionStatus$State is in a SUCCEEDED or FAILED state. The remaining non-timeline statistics in the response (like stage-level input and output row count and data…

GetResourceDashboard.name: GetResourceDashboard
GetResourceDashboard.doc: Gets the Live UI/Persistence UI for a session.

GetSession.name: GetSession
GetSession.doc: Gets the full details of a previously created session, including the session status and configuration.

GetSessionEndpoint.name: GetSessionEndpoint
GetSessionEndpoint.doc: Gets a connection endpoint and authentication token for a given session Id.

GetSessionStatus.name: GetSessionStatus
GetSessionStatus.doc: Gets the current status of a session.

GetTableMetadata.name: GetTableMetadata
GetTableMetadata.doc: Returns table metadata for the specified catalog, database, and table.

GetWorkGroup.name: GetWorkGroup
GetWorkGroup.doc: Returns information about the workgroup with the specified name.

ImportNotebook.name: ImportNotebook
ImportNotebook.doc: Imports a single ipynb file to a Spark enabled workgroup. To import the notebook, the request must specify a value for either Payload or NoteBookS3LocationUri. If neither is specified or both are specified, an InvalidRequestException occurs. The maximum file size that can be imported is 10 megabytes. If an ipynb file with the same name already exists in the workgroup, throws an error.

ListApplicationDPUSizes.name: ListApplicationDPUSizes
ListApplicationDPUSizes.doc: Returns the supported DPU sizes for the supported application runtimes (for example, Athena notebook version 1).

ListCalculationExecutions.name: ListCalculationExecutions
ListCalculationExecutions.doc: Lists the calculations that have been submitted to a session in descending order. Newer calculations are listed first; older calculations are listed later.

ListCapacityReservations.name: ListCapacityReservations
ListCapacityReservations.doc: Lists the capacity reservations for the current account.

ListDatabases.name: ListDatabases
ListDatabases.doc: Lists the databases in the specified data catalog.

ListDataCatalogs.name: ListDataCatalogs
ListDataCatalogs.doc: Lists the data catalogs in the current Amazon Web Services account. In the Athena console, data catalogs are listed as "data sources" on the Data sources page under the Data source name column.

ListEngineVersions.name: ListEngineVersions
ListEngineVersions.doc: Returns a list of engine versions that are available to choose from, including the Auto option.

ListExecutors.name: ListExecutors
ListExecutors.doc: Lists, in descending order, the executors that joined a session. Newer executors are listed first; older executors are listed later. The result can be optionally filtered by state.

ListNamedQueries.name: ListNamedQueries
ListNamedQueries.doc: Provides a list of available query IDs only for queries saved in the specified workgroup. Requires that you have access to the specified workgroup. If a workgroup is not specified, lists the saved queries for the primary workgroup.

ListNotebookMetadata.name: ListNotebookMetadata
ListNotebookMetadata.doc: Displays the notebook files for the specified workgroup in paginated format.

ListNotebookSessions.name: ListNotebookSessions
ListNotebookSessions.doc: Lists, in descending order, the sessions that have been created in a notebook that are in an active state like CREATING, CREATED, IDLE or BUSY. Newer sessions are listed first; older sessions are listed later.

ListPreparedStatements.name: ListPreparedStatements
ListPreparedStatements.doc: Lists the prepared statements in the specified workgroup.

ListQueryExecutions.name: ListQueryExecutions
ListQueryExecutions.doc: Provides a list of available query execution IDs for the queries in the specified workgroup. Athena keeps a query history for 45 days. If a workgroup is not specified, returns a list of query execution IDs for the primary workgroup. Requires you to have access to the workgroup in which the queries ran.

ListSessions.name: ListSessions
ListSessions.doc: Lists the sessions in a workgroup that are in an active state like CREATING, CREATED, IDLE, or BUSY. Newer sessions are listed first; older sessions are listed later.

ListTableMetadata.name: ListTableMetadata
ListTableMetadata.doc: Lists the metadata for the tables in the specified data catalog database.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.doc: Lists the tags associated with an Athena resource.

ListWorkGroups.name: ListWorkGroups
ListWorkGroups.doc: Lists available workgroups for the account.

PutCapacityAssignmentConfiguration.name: PutCapacityAssignmentConfiguration
PutCapacityAssignmentConfiguration.doc: Puts a new capacity assignment configuration for a specified capacity reservation. If a capacity assignment configuration already exists for the capacity reservation, replaces the existing capacity assignment configuration.

StartCalculationExecution.name: StartCalculationExecution
StartCalculationExecution.doc: Submits calculations for execution within a session. You can supply the code to run as an inline code block within the request. The request syntax requires the StartCalculationExecutionRequest$CodeBlock parameter or the CalculationConfiguration$CodeBlock parameter, but not both. Because CalculationConfiguration$CodeBlock is deprecated, use the StartCalculationExecutionRequest$CodeBlock parameter…

StartQueryExecution.name: StartQueryExecution
StartQueryExecution.doc: Runs the SQL query statements contained in the Query. Requires you to have access to the workgroup in which the query ran. Running queries against an external catalog requires GetDataCatalog permission to the catalog. For code samples using the Amazon Web Services SDK for Java, see Examples and Code Samples in the Amazon Athena User Guide.

StartSession.name: StartSession
StartSession.doc: Creates a session for running calculations within a workgroup. The session is ready when it reaches an IDLE state.

StopCalculationExecution.name: StopCalculationExecution
StopCalculationExecution.doc: Requests the cancellation of a calculation. A StopCalculationExecution call on a calculation that is already in a terminal state (for example, STOPPED, FAILED, or COMPLETED) succeeds but has no effect. Cancelling a calculation is done on a best effort basis. If a calculation cannot be cancelled, you can be charged for its completion. If you are concerned about being charged for a calculation that…

StopQueryExecution.name: StopQueryExecution
StopQueryExecution.doc: Stops a query execution. Requires you to have access to the workgroup in which the query ran.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.doc: Adds one or more tags to an Athena resource. A tag is a label that you assign to a resource. Each tag consists of a key and an optional value, both of which you define. For example, you can use tags to categorize Athena workgroups, data catalogs, or capacity reservations by purpose, owner, or environment. Use a consistent set of tag keys to make it easier to search and filter the resources in…

TerminateSession.name: TerminateSession
TerminateSession.doc: Terminates an active session. A TerminateSession call on a session that is already inactive (for example, in a FAILED, TERMINATED or TERMINATING state) succeeds but has no effect. Calculations running in the session when TerminateSession is called are forcefully stopped, but may display as FAILED instead of STOPPED.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.doc: Removes one or more tags from an Athena resource.

UpdateCapacityReservation.name: UpdateCapacityReservation
UpdateCapacityReservation.doc: Updates the number of requested data processing units for the capacity reservation with the specified name.

UpdateDataCatalog.name: UpdateDataCatalog
UpdateDataCatalog.doc: Updates the data catalog that has the specified name.

UpdateNamedQuery.name: UpdateNamedQuery
UpdateNamedQuery.doc: Updates a NamedQuery object. The database or workgroup cannot be updated.

UpdateNotebook.name: UpdateNotebook
UpdateNotebook.doc: Updates the contents of a Spark notebook.

UpdateNotebookMetadata.name: UpdateNotebookMetadata
UpdateNotebookMetadata.doc: Updates the metadata for a notebook.

UpdateWorkGroup.name: UpdateWorkGroup
UpdateWorkGroup.doc: Updates the workgroup with the specified name. The workgroup's name cannot be changed. Only ConfigurationUpdates can be specified.

S3AclOption.doc: The Amazon S3 canned ACL that Athena should specify when storing query results, including data files inserted by Athena as the result of statements like CTAS or INSERT INTO. Currently the only supported canned ACL is BUCKET_OWNER_FULL_CONTROL. If a query runs in a workgroup and the workgroup overrides client-side settings, then the Amazon S3 canned ACL specified in the workgroup's settings is…

AclConfiguration.doc: Indicates that an Amazon S3 canned ACL should be set to control ownership of stored query results, including data files inserted by Athena as the result of statements like CTAS or INSERT INTO. When Athena stores query results in Amazon S3, the canned ACL is set with the x-amz-acl request header. For more information about S3 Object Ownership, see Object Ownership settings in the Amazon S3 User…

ApplicationRuntimeId.doc: The name of the supported application runtime (for example, Athena notebook version 1).

SupportedDPUSizes.doc: A list of the supported DPU sizes that the application runtime supports.

ApplicationDPUSizes.doc: Contains the application runtime IDs and their supported DPU sizes.

ErrorCategory.doc: An integer value that specifies the category of a query failure error. The following list shows the category for each integer value. 1 - System 2 - User 3 - Other

ErrorType.doc: An integer value that provides specific information about an Athena query error. For the meaning of specific values, see the Error Type Reference in the Amazon Athena User Guide.

Retryable.doc: True if the query might succeed if resubmitted.

ErrorMessage.doc: Contains a short description of the error that occurred.

AthenaError.doc: Provides information about an Athena query error. The AthenaError feature provides standardized error information to help you understand failed queries and take steps after a query failure occurs. AthenaError includes an ErrorCategory field that specifies whether the cause of the failed query is due to system error, user error, or other error.

BatchGetNamedQueryInput.doc: Contains an array of named query IDs.

NamedQueries.doc: Information about the named query IDs submitted.

PreparedStatementNames.doc: A list of prepared statement names to return.

WorkGroup.doc: The name of the workgroup to which the prepared statements belong.

PreparedStatements.doc: The list of prepared statements returned.

UnprocessedPreparedStatementNames.doc: A list of one or more prepared statements that were requested but could not be returned.

QueryExecutionIds.doc: An array of query execution IDs.

BatchGetQueryExecutionInput.doc: Contains an array of query execution IDs.

UnprocessedQueryExecutionIds.doc: Information about the query executions that failed to run.

CodeBlock.doc: A string that contains the code for the calculation.

CalculationConfiguration.doc: Contains configuration information for the calculation.

StdOutS3Uri.doc: The Amazon S3 location of the stdout file for the calculation.

StdErrorS3Uri.doc: The Amazon S3 location of the stderr error messages file for the calculation.

ResultS3Uri.doc: The Amazon S3 location of the folder for the calculation results.

ResultType.doc: The data format of the calculation result.

CalculationResult.doc: Contains information about an application-specific calculation result.

DpuExecutionInMillis.doc: The data processing unit execution time in milliseconds for the calculation.

CalculationStatistics.doc: Contains statistics for a notebook calculation.

SubmissionDateTime.doc: The date and time the calculation was submitted for processing.

CompletionDateTime.doc: The date and time the calculation completed processing.

State.doc: The state of the calculation execution. A description of each state follows. CREATING - The calculation is in the process of being created. CREATED - The calculation has been created and is ready to run. QUEUED - The calculation has been queued for processing. RUNNING - The calculation is running. CANCELING - A request to cancel the calculation has been received and the system is working to stop…

StateChangeReason.doc: The reason for the calculation state change (for example, the calculation was canceled because the session was terminated).

CalculationStatus.doc: Contains information about the status of a notebook calculation.

Status.doc: Contains information about the status of the calculation.

CalculationSummary.doc: Summary information for a notebook calculation.

Name.doc: The name of the capacity reservation to cancel.

Status.doc: The status of the capacity allocation.

StatusMessage.doc: The status message of the capacity allocation.

RequestTime.doc: The time when the capacity allocation was requested.

RequestCompletionTime.doc: The time when the capacity allocation request was completed.

CapacityAllocation.doc: Contains the submission time of a single allocation request for a capacity reservation and the most recent status of the attempted allocation.

WorkGroupNames.doc: The list of workgroup names for the capacity assignment.

CapacityAssignment.doc: A mapping between one or more workgroups and a capacity reservation.

CapacityReservationName.doc: The name of the reservation that the capacity assignment configuration is for.

CapacityAssignments.doc: The list of assignments that make up the capacity assignment configuration.

CapacityAssignmentConfiguration.doc: Assigns Athena workgroups (and hence their queries) to capacity reservations. A capacity reservation can have only one capacity assignment configuration, but the capacity assignment configuration can be made up of multiple individual assignments. Each assignment specifies how Athena queries can consume capacity from the capacity reservation that their workgroup is mapped to.

Name.doc: The name of the capacity reservation.

Status.doc: The status of the capacity reservation.

TargetDpus.doc: The number of data processing units requested.

AllocatedDpus.doc: The number of data processing units currently allocated.

LastSuccessfulAllocationTime.doc: The time of the most recent capacity allocation that succeeded.

CreationTime.doc: The time in UTC epoch millis when the capacity reservation was created.

CapacityReservation.doc: A reservation for a specified number of data processing units (DPUs). When a reservation is initially created, it has no DPUs. Athena allocates DPUs until the allocated amount equals the requested amount.

Name.doc: The name of the configuration classification.

Properties.doc: A set of properties specified within a configuration classification.

Classification.doc: A classification refers to a set of specific configurations.

LogGroup.doc: The name of the log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs where you want to publish your logs.

LogStreamNamePrefix.doc: Prefix for the CloudWatch log stream name.

LogTypes.doc: The types of logs that you want to publish to CloudWatch.

CloudWatchLoggingConfiguration.doc: Configuration settings for delivering logs to Amazon CloudWatch log groups.

Name.doc: The name of the column.

Type.doc: The data type of the column.

Column.doc: Contains metadata for a column in a table.

CatalogName.doc: The catalog to which the query results belong.

SchemaName.doc: The schema name (database name) to which the query results belong.

TableName.doc: The table name for the query results.

Name.doc: The name of the column.

Type.doc: The data type of the column.

Precision.doc: For DECIMAL data types, specifies the total number of digits, up to 38. For performance reasons, we recommend up to 18 digits.

Scale.doc: For DECIMAL data types, specifies the total number of digits in the fractional part of the value. Defaults to 0.

Nullable.doc: Unsupported constraint. This value always shows as UNKNOWN.

CaseSensitive.doc: Indicates whether values in the column are case-sensitive.

ColumnInfo.doc: Information about the columns in a query execution result.

Tags.doc: The tags for the capacity reservation.

The catalog name must be unique for the Amazon Web Services account and can use a maximum of 127 alphanumeric, underscore, at sign, or hyphen characters. The remainder of the length constraint of 256 is reserved for use by Athena. For FEDERATED type the catalog name has following considerations and limits: The catalog name allows special characters such as…

FEDERATED is a federated catalog for which Athena creates the connection and the Lambda function for you based on the parameters that you pass. For FEDERATED type, we do not support IAM identity center.

For the HIVE data catalog type, use the following syntax. The metadata-function parameter is required. Tags.doc: A list of comma separated tags to add to the data catalog that is created. All the resources that are created by the CreateDataCatalog API operation with FEDERATED type will have the tag federated_athena_datacatalog="true". This includes the CFN Stack, Glue Connection, Athena DataCatalog, and all the resources created as part of the CFN Stack (Lambda Function, IAM policies/roles).

Name.doc: The query name.

Database.doc: The database to which the query belongs.

QueryString.doc: The contents of the query with all query statements.

ClientRequestToken.doc: A unique case-sensitive string used to ensure the request to create the query is idempotent (executes only once). If another CreateNamedQuery request is received, the same response is returned and another query is not created. If a parameter has changed, for example, the QueryString, an error is returned. WorkGroup.doc: The name of the workgroup in which the named query is being created.

NamedQueryId.doc: The unique ID of the query.

WorkGroup.doc: The name of the Spark enabled workgroup in which the notebook will be created.

This token is listed as not required because Amazon Web Services SDKs (for example the Amazon Web Services SDK for Java) auto-generate the token for you. If you are not using the Amazon Web Services SDK or the Amazon Web Services CLI, you must provide this token or the action will…

NotebookId.doc: A unique identifier for the notebook.

StatementName.doc: The name of the prepared statement.

WorkGroup.doc: The name of the workgroup to which the prepared statement belongs.

QueryStatement.doc: The query string for the prepared statement.

Description.doc: The description of the prepared statement.

NotebookUrl.doc: The URL of the notebook. The URL includes the authentication token and notebook file name and points directly to the opened notebook.

AuthToken.doc: The authentication token for the notebook.

AuthTokenExpirationTime.doc: The UTC epoch time when the authentication token expires.

Name.doc: The workgroup name.

Configuration.doc: Contains configuration information for creating an Athena SQL workgroup or Spark enabled Athena workgroup. Athena SQL workgroup configuration includes the location in Amazon S3 where query and calculation results are stored, the encryption configuration, if any, used for encrypting query results, whether the Amazon CloudWatch Metrics are enabled for the workgroup, the limit for the amount of…

Tags.doc: A list of comma separated tags to add to the workgroup that is created.

KmsKey.doc: The customer managed KMS key that is used to encrypt the user's data stores in Athena.

CustomerContentEncryptionConfiguration.doc: Specifies the customer managed KMS key that is used to encrypt the user's data stores in Athena. When an Amazon Web Services managed key is used, this value is null. This setting does not apply to Athena SQL workgroups.

Name.doc: The name of the data catalog. The catalog name must be unique for the Amazon Web Services account and can use a maximum of 127 alphanumeric, underscore, at sign, or hyphen characters. The remainder of the length constraint of 256 is reserved for use by Athena.

Description.doc: An optional description of the data catalog.

Type.doc: The type of data catalog to create: LAMBDA for a federated catalog, GLUE for an Glue Data Catalog, and HIVE for an external Apache Hive metastore. FEDERATED is a federated catalog for which Athena creates the connection and the Lambda function for you based on the parameters that you pass.

For the HIVE data catalog type, use the following syntax. The metadata-function parameter is required. Status.doc: The status of the creation or deletion of the data catalog. The LAMBDA, GLUE, and HIVE data catalog types are created synchronously. Their status is either CREATE_COMPLETE or CREATE_FAILED. The FEDERATED data catalog type is created asynchronously. Data catalog creation status: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS: Federated data catalog creation in progress. CREATE_COMPLETE: Data catalog creation complete.…

ConnectionType.doc: The type of connection for a FEDERATED data catalog (for example, REDSHIFT, MYSQL, or SQLSERVER). For information about individual connectors, see Available data source connectors.

Error.doc: Text of the error that occurred during data catalog creation or deletion.

DataCatalog.doc: Contains information about a data catalog in an Amazon Web Services account. In the Athena console, data catalogs are listed as "data sources" on the Data sources page under the Data source name column.

CatalogName.doc: The name of the data catalog. The catalog name is unique for the Amazon Web Services account and can use a maximum of 127 alphanumeric, underscore, at sign, or hyphen characters. The remainder of the length constraint of 256 is reserved for use by Athena.

Status.doc: The status of the creation or deletion of the data catalog. The LAMBDA, GLUE, and HIVE data catalog types are created synchronously. Their status is either CREATE_COMPLETE or CREATE_FAILED. The FEDERATED data catalog type is created asynchronously. Data catalog creation status: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS: Federated data catalog creation in progress. CREATE_COMPLETE: Data catalog creation complete.…

ConnectionType.doc: The type of connection for a FEDERATED data catalog (for example, REDSHIFT, MYSQL, or SQLSERVER). For information about individual connectors, see Available data source connectors.

Error.doc: Text of the error that occurred during data catalog creation or deletion.

DataCatalogSummary.doc: The summary information for the data catalog, which includes its name and type.

Name.doc: The name of the database.

Description.doc: An optional description of the database.

Parameters.doc: A set of custom key/value pairs.

Database.doc: Contains metadata information for a database in a data catalog.

Datum.doc: A piece of data (a field in the table).

NamedQueryId.doc: The unique ID of the query to delete.

NotebookId.doc: The ID of the notebook to delete.

StatementName.doc: The name of the prepared statement to delete.

WorkGroup.doc: The workgroup to which the statement to be deleted belongs.
The unique name of the workgroup to delete.

RecursiveDeleteOption.doc: The option to delete the workgroup and its contents even if the workgroup contains any named queries, query executions, or notebooks.

EncryptionOption.doc: Indicates whether Amazon S3 server-side encryption with Amazon S3-managed keys (SSE_S3), server-side encryption with KMS-managed keys (SSE_KMS), or client-side encryption with KMS-managed keys (CSE_KMS) is used. KmsKey.doc: For SSE_KMS and CSE_KMS, this is the KMS key ARN or ID.

EncryptionConfiguration.doc: If query and calculation results are encrypted in Amazon S3, indicates the encryption option used (for example, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS) and key information.

CoordinatorDpuSize.doc: The number of DPUs to use for the coordinator. A coordinator is a special executor that orchestrates processing work and manages other executors in a notebook session. The default is 1.

MaxConcurrentDpus.doc: The maximum number of DPUs that can run concurrently.

DefaultExecutorDpuSize.doc: The default number of DPUs to use for executors. An executor is the smallest unit of compute that a notebook session can request from Athena. The default is 1.

AdditionalConfigs.doc: Contains additional notebook engine MAP<string, string> parameter mappings in the form of key-value pairs. To specify an Athena notebook that the Jupyter server will download and serve, specify a value for the StartSessionRequest$NotebookVersion field, and then add a key named NotebookId to AdditionalConfigs that has the value of the Athena notebook ID.

SparkProperties.doc: Specifies custom jar files and Spark properties for use cases like cluster encryption, table formats, and general Spark tuning.

Classifications.doc: The configuration classifications that can be specified for the engine.

EngineConfiguration.doc: The engine configuration for the workgroup, which includes the minimum/maximum number of Data Processing Units (DPU) that queries should use when running in provisioned capacity. If not specified, Athena uses default values (Default value for min is 4 and for max is Minimum of 124 and allocated DPUs). To specify DPU values for PC queries the WG containing EngineConfiguration should have the…
